title: Update provider.h: replace set_sig/get_sig with sign/verify/agree ops
description: In include/crypto2dev_provider.h: remove set_sig and get_sig function pointer fields from crypto2dev_algo_ops; add sign(void *key_ctx, const u8 *digest, u32 digestlen, u8 *sig, u32 bufsz, u32 *siglen); add verify(void *key_ctx, const u8 *digest, u32 digestlen, const u8 *sig, u32 siglen) returns 0 or -EBADMSG; add agree(void *key_ctx, const u8 *peer_pub, u32 peer_publen, u8 *secret, u32 bufsz, u32 *secretlen); add sess_reset(void *ctx) returns -EOPNOTSUPP if NULL.
